_comment: NEXORA devnet parameters (Phase 2). Single source of truth for ci/phase2/*.sh. DEVNET ONLY - not mainnet, not a public network. Reversible: nothing here modifies the upstream reference code.
bech32_note: Kept as upstream 'cosmos' on purpose: changing the SDK bech32 prefix is a code-level change in the reference binary and is out of Phase 2 scope (config-only phase).

fees._note: evmd's feemarket initial base fee is 1 gwei = 1e9 anex per gas and decays across blocks, so 2e9 anex/gas is used to always clear the current base fee. Observed requirement in the first blocks: ~448795318 anex/gas (see docs/phase2-report.md).

upstream_keys.source: Parsed at runtime from the upstream, unmodified /tmp/cosmos-evm/local_node.sh (public upstream test mnemonics). No key material is stored in this repository.

_chain_id_note: EIP-155 format so wallets and tooling that expect eip155:<id> recognise this chain. The numeric id matches evm_chain_id (902024 / 0xdc388). Changing this regenerates genesis and invalidates all prior state.
